title: Chapter 27: New Item
html:
Chen Ge walked through the set to familiarize himself with it. The layout strongly resembled Ping An Apartments, but the black phone had exaggerated its claustrophobic atmosphere. More than a dozen effects were hidden throughout the attraction, and several rooms connected through concealed passages.

It feels authentic. This could work almost like an escape-room challenge. I should test it with visitors today.

The setting brought back uncomfortable memories of the previous night. Chen Ge had, after all, experienced the inspiration for this scenario firsthand. With customers waiting downstairs, he only had time for a quick inspection before leaving.

Before he even reached the entrance, he heard Xu Wan addressing the crowd. “Please be patient. I’m sure Boss will be out soon. In the meantime, you’re welcome to try some of the park’s other attractions.”

“Is your boss really in there? We watched his livestream last night. He disappeared into the woods in the middle of all that chaos. Did he actually make it back?”

“I watched too! The last part was just shouting and darkness. I honestly thought the stream was going to end there.”

“Were we watching the same livestream? The screen was black for most of it. How did all of you invent an entire action movie?”

“Either way, we came to see whether the host survived his own content.”

The discussion grew loud enough to draw Uncle Xu’s attention. Seeing such a large crowd outside the Haunted House left him both pleased and uneasy. The attraction, which had seemed close to collapse not long ago, was suddenly becoming one of New Century Park’s busiest draws, with visitors lining up early in the morning.

Under ordinary circumstances, that would have been excellent news. Unfortunately, the conversations he overheard from the queue made him wonder exactly what kind of reputation Chen Ge was building.This can’t keep escalating. Next time I see Xiao Chen, I need to talk to him. The boy works hard, but hard work shouldn’t mean courting trouble every other night.

The gate opened and Chen Ge stepped outside. “Sorry to keep everyone waiting. We’re open now. Tickets are twenty yuan, and young children aren’t admitted.”

The crowd went quiet for half a second before several viewers of the previous night’s stream rushed over with questions. Chen Ge enjoyed his brief burst of celebrity, then restored order and began admitting visitors in groups.

After the previous mishap, he no longer played Black Friday on a loop. Instead, he mixed it into a larger playlist so it would appear unpredictably. He helped Xu Wan with her makeup, sent her into the Minghun scenario, and stayed at the entrance to sell tickets.

Visitor numbers are rising, and our reputation is spreading. If this continues, I should meet the expansion requirement within a few days.

He took out the black phone to check his progress toward expansion and see what daily missions had appeared.

Easy Mission: A frightening experience still needs rhythm. If every scare comes too early, visitors quickly become numb to it. Install basic monitoring equipment so you can understand how guests move through the attraction and pace the experience accordingly.

Normal Mission: Surprise is one of the foundations of effective horror. Review the attraction and make sure obvious points of attention are not always where the real effect occurs.

Nightmare Mission: Strange sounds can be heard from the bathroom every midnight. If you want to learn their source, follow the instructions.

Daily Missions refresh at midnight. The user may accept only one each day, and rewards correspond to mission difficulty.

Warning: More difficult missions carry greater risk. Choose carefully.

After a quick glance, Chen Ge immediately ruled out the Nightmare Mission. Two sleepless nights were enough. He already had one unexplained mirror apparition to worry about and had no desire to add another mystery before getting some rest.

Nightmare Missions seem to give rewards that affect me directly, but the risk rises with the reward. That can wait. The Easy Mission requires equipment I can’t afford until the reward money comes through.

That left the Normal Mission as the obvious choice.Using a visitor’s attention against their expectations is a good principle. I can improve several rooms with that.

After accepting the Normal Mission, Chen Ge remained near the entrance while keeping in touch with Xu Wan.

By noon, the crowd had thinned. He sent Xu Wan to lunch and returned to Minghun alone. He had designed the scenario himself and knew every beat of its pacing, so he spent the afternoon adjusting effects and sightlines to satisfy the mission’s requirement.

Visitors entered a Haunted House expecting to be frightened, which made predictable scares less effective. Chen Ge therefore focused on misdirection—giving them one obvious thing to watch while another harmless theatrical effect arrived from somewhere unexpected.

The Normal Mission proved much easier than he had expected. Within a few hours, the black phone notified him that the work was complete.

“Normal Mission complete. Fear can be created in many ways, but surprise remains one of the most effective. Reward obtained: Doctor Skull-Cracker’s Uniform.”

“Doctor Skull-Cracker’s Uniform (Attire): Clark worked at an isolated hospital for more than twenty years. Over time, obsession replaced compassion, and he became convinced that every problem had one radical cure. The uniform he left behind still carries the oppressive atmosphere of that institution.”

It was the second physical reward Chen Ge had received after Black Friday. The black phone informed him that the item had appeared in the props room.

Perfect timing. This should fit Murder by Midnight beautifully.

Several ideas immediately came to him. He had just picked up a pen to write them down when his regular phone rang.

“He San?” Chen Ge answered. “What’s up?”

“Boss, remember what I warned you about?” He San kept his voice low, apparently afraid of being overheard. “Some seniors from my department decided they need to restore Senior Gao Ru Xue’s honor after you frightened her last time. They’re on their way now, so be prepared.”
